Gaming & Emulation tutorial

umu-launcher on Omarchy

Proton for your Windows games, no Steam required.

Package data synced 2026-10-17 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install umu-launcher on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add umu-launcher. It is a 98.7 KB download (362 KB installed), version 1.1.3-1.1, licensed GPL-3.0-only. This is the Unified Launcher for Windows Games on Linux, to run Proton with fixes outside of Steam. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install umu-launcher on Omarchy

umu-launcher packages Valve's Proton compatibility tooling and the Steam Linux Runtime so any launcher, not just Steam, can run Windows games on Linux. Tools like Lutris, Heroic, and Bottles use it under the hood to set up the Wine prefix, pick a Proton version, and apply community game-specific fixes automatically.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add umu-launcher
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.1.3-1.1:
    pacman -Qi umu-launcher

Open and use umu-launcher

umu-launcher has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql umu-launcher | grep /usr/bin/

umu-launcher requirements and compatibility

  • A Proton or Proton-compatible build to actually run games
  • Network access to download the Steam Runtime and game-fix database on first run

Frequently asked questions

How do I install umu-launcher on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add umu-launcher. The download is 98.7 KB and it takes 362 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is umu-launcher free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL-3.0-only.

How do I uninstall umu-launcher?

Run omarchy pkg drop umu-launcher. It removes the package from your system.

What does umu-launcher depend on?

The package declares 11 dependencies: bash, curl, dbus, diffutils, glibc, gcc-libs, libxcrypt, lsof, python, python-xlib, python-filelock. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is umu-launcher a desktop app?

No. umu-launcher has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is umu-launcher in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as umu-launcher (version 1.1.3-1.1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Open Wine Components makes it. Project site: https://github.com/Open-Wine-Components/umu-launcher. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
